name: DataGridErrorState
purpose: Table-row error state for data-grid load failures.

guidance.useWhen: Use when the grid has a string or Error value representing a load failure.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for empty or loading states; the component renders nothing when error is absent.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Pass only actual grid-load errors; do not use the component for no-data or loading conditions.

accessibility: The containing table cell uses role="alert" and wraps the shared ErrorState.
knownLimitations: Use for grid load errors; it renders nothing when no error is present and is not an empty/loading state.
